words.word: shall be there nor any ravenous

occurrences.text: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
words: shall be there nor any ravenous

occurrences.text: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the Lord.
My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,
And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
